cond_0001.intro:

Monitor and manage Technology Risk by providing enterprise-wide oversight and governance for technology risk management activities within [Company name masked]. Assists with the execution of various risk frameworks across the organization by monitoring and reporting on risk activities and framework compliance for identifying, assessing, and reporting on risk related activities. Builds productive working relationships with the technology, risk and operational groups within the company providing tools, capabilities, and frameworks to evolve the maturity of those group. Actively manages and escalates risk and customer-impacting issues within the day-to-day role to management.

Contributes towards effective collaboration across all 3 lines of defense on Technology Risk management related activities.
